<!-- Python code makes on target editing bar plot, and off target sites plot -->
```{python}
#| include: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

report_data = r.report_data

def parse_offtarget_data(data):
    """Parse the off-target data and return x and y values."""
    x_values, y_values = [], []
    for record in data:
        try:
            chrom, start, end = record['chrom'], record['start'], record['end']
            indel_fraction = float(record['indel_fraction'])
            is_target = int(record['is_target_site'])
            
            if indel_fraction == 0:
                continue

            loci = f"{chrom}:{start}-{end}"
            x_values.append(loci)
            y_values.append(indel_fraction * 100)  # Convert to percentage
        except (ValueError, IndexError, KeyError):
            continue
    return x_values, y_values

on_target_records = [r for r in report_data['tables']['off_target_indels'] if r.get('is_target_site') == '1']
off_target_records = [r for r in report_data['tables']['off_target_indels'] if r.get('is_target_site') == '0']

on_target_x, on_target_y = parse_offtarget_data(on_target_records)
off_target_x, off_target_y = parse_offtarget_data(off_target_records)

def plot_bar_chart(x_values, y_values, xlabel, ylabel, title, output_file, type, highlight_line=None):
    """Create and save a bar chart."""
    if type == 'on target':
        plt.figure(figsize=(9, 9.5))
    else:
        plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))
    plt.bar(x_values, y_values, color='skyblue')
    if highlight_line:
        plt.axhline(y=highlight_line['value'], color=highlight_line['color'], linestyle='-', linewidth=2)
        plt.text(x=len(x_values)-0.5, y=highlight_line['value'], s=highlight_line['label'], 
                 color=highlight_line['color'], fontsize=12, va='bottom', ha='right')
    plt.xlabel(rf"{xlabel}", fontsize=20)
    plt.ylabel(rf"{ylabel}", fontsize=20)
    plt.xticks([])
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(output_file, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()

if on_target_x:
    plot_bar_chart(on_target_x, on_target_y, 'On-target loci', 'Indel frequency (%)', 'On-target editing', 'indel_freq.png', 'on target')

if off_target_x:
    plot_bar_chart(off_target_x, off_target_y, 'Predicted off-target sites', 'Indel frequency (%)', 'Off-target sites', 'off_targets.png', 'off target', {'value': r.params['off_target_threshold'], 'color': 'red', 'label': f"{r.params['off_target_threshold']}%"})
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'
off_target_df <- as.data.frame(report_data$tables$off_target_indels)
off_target_filtered <- off_target_df[as.numeric(off_target_df$indel_fraction) * 100 > r.params['off_target_threshold'] & off_target_df$is_target_site == '0',]
if(nrow(off_target_filtered) > 0){
    cat('<table class="white-background-table off-target-subtable">')
    cat("<tr><th>Genome Coordinate</th><th>% Indels</th><th>Annotation</th></tr>")
    for(i in 1:nrow(off_target_filtered)){
        coord <- paste0(off_target_filtered[i, "chrom"], ":", off_target_filtered[i, "start"])
        indels <- paste0(round(as.numeric(off_target_filtered[i, "indel_fraction"]) * 100, 1), "%")
        annotation <- off_target_filtered[i, "annotation"]
        cat(paste0("<tr><td>", coord, "</td><td>", indels, "</td><td>", annotation, "</td></tr>"))
    }
    cat("</table>")
} else {
    cat("<p>No off-target sites with > 1.0% indel frequency found.</p>")
}
```
